name: Summit AZ - SEO Change Log
body:
> Log · Summit Az · 2026-10-22

# Summary
The master, append-only log of every live change on summitplumbingpros.com since Sep 2, 2026. Columns: Date, Time (UTC), Who, System, Change, Scope / URLs, Evidence, Verified?, SEO risk to watch, Re-check. About 150 rows (101 in September, 49 in October through Oct 22). It is the source of truth that the case study and reports cite.

# October 2026 highlights
- Oct 1: keyword targeting audit (no changes); 2 blog focus keywords changed to stop competing with service pages (signs of a slab leak, trenchless sewer repair); index checks and Request Indexing.
- Oct 3: striking-distance batch, 3 pages rewritten (drain cleaning Fountain Hills, sewer Fountain Hills, sewer Queen Creek); pipe lining unsourced local claims removed; swapped FAQs fixed on Scottsdale and Tempe pipe lining.
- Oct 5 and 7: Request Indexing for the 7 not-indexed rewrites; 13 in-text links; water pressure Phoenix retargeted to "PRV replacement Phoenix"; shower and faucet FAQ schema.
- Oct 7 to 8: homepage duplicate H1 (mobile widget to H2), meta shortened, Article schema off (Scott approved); Rank Math llms.txt module enabled; brand-name fixes on /water-softeners/ and em dashes fixed on the leaking pipe page.
- Oct 9: schema fixes (emptied /about/ hand-coded block, Pages default schema to None on 149 pages, 24 pages reassigned to author "Summit Plumbing Pros", priceRange removed from the city-page plugin); 3 fixture city pages rewritten; Gilbert generic-content revision.
- Oct 13: "Grease in Drain" blog published (post 11570) with internal links.
- Oct 16: 31 Rank Math titles shortened; /plumbing/ services list rebuilt, Why Choose contrast fixed, retargeted to "residential plumbing services".
- Oct 21 to 22: GBP map embed on homepage; mobile hero container removed by Kim; 5 homepage service card links restored; footer Facebook, Instagram, YouTube icons; Rank Math Local SEO address, GBP phone and sameAs added; "LLC" removed from schema name per Scott.

# How it is used
- Every live change gets a row with evidence and a re-check date (many September rows point at Oct 2).
- Undo details and server backup paths live in the Evidence column.
